shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: It is a big dog. / It is a small dog. / The bike is new. / The bike is used.
assets.prompt: IN A PARK, from left to right: a BIG dog (a large shaggy dog, very tall) standing on the grass; a SMALL dog (a tiny puppy-sized dog) standing on the grass; a shiny NEW bicycle, spotless bright red paint, standing on its kickstand; an OLD USED bicycle with faded scratched paint, rust on the chain and a worn seat, standing on its kickstand. The two dogs are clearly different sizes; the two bikes are clearly new versus old. No people. Exactly four subjects, spread evenly across the whole width of the photo, each clearly separated from the others by open space, none overlapping or hidden, each large and sharp. Eye-level view, the whole of every subject visible. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: It is a yellow pencil. / It is a red pencil. / It is a blue notebook. / It is a green notebook.
assets.prompt: SCHOOL THINGS ON A WOODEN PICNIC TABLE in a park, seen from above. From left to right, lying flat and well apart: one long YELLOW pencil; one long RED pencil; one closed BLUE notebook; one closed GREEN notebook. The pencils lie vertically (pointing from the top of the photo to the bottom) so each is long in the frame. Plain covers, nothing else on the table. Exactly four subjects, spread evenly across the whole width of the photo, each clearly separated from the others by open space, none overlapping or hidden, each large and sharp. Eye-level view, the whole of every subject visible. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: It is a brown dog. / It is a gray cat. / It is a pink bag. / It is a purple chair.
assets.prompt: IN A PARK on a sunny day, from left to right: a BROWN dog sitting on the grass; a GRAY cat sitting on the grass; a PINK handbag standing on the grass; a PURPLE folding chair standing on the grass. Each has one clear solid color. No people, no other animals, no other bags or chairs. Exactly four subjects, spread evenly across the whole width of the photo, each clearly separated from the others by open space, none overlapping or hidden, each large and sharp. Eye-level view, the whole of every subject visible. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.
